crossRefs.note: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen!…
When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and…

translations.web: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
translations.bsb: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
translations.kjv: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
translations.asv: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.
